nodes.label: FR-09 — Publish to WordPress or mark ManualReady on approval
nodes.description: Functional requirement FR-09. In V1 only the LinkedIn target-level ManualReady publication event is in scope (D-243), requested by ROLE-SENIOR-JOURNALIST after an accepted final business:T5 record (D-250); ManualReady is an event, not an article state. Automated WordPress publication, retry and scheduling are a V2-target backlog with no V2 opened. [V1] origin retained.

nodes.label: FR-10 — Confirm manual publish via live URL
nodes.description: Functional requirement FR-10: confirm a manual publish by entering a live URL, promoting the target and then the article to Published. Under D-243 this runtime behaviour is a V2-target backlog item outside V1; the section keeps its [V1] origin and no [V1 to V2] marker is used while no V2 build exists.

nodes.label: D-247: current V1 boundary
nodes.description: V1 is V1-SM05 and V1-SM06 and ends at the bounded LinkedIn target-level ManualReady outcome. It satisfies the customer's CR-19 scenario only partially; the five-gate execution and Chief Journalist approval it names are neither admitted into V1 nor assigned a destination. WordPress, retry and FR-10/T11 remain V2 targets under D-243.

nodes.label: D-248: D-244 lifecycle correction, closure pending
nodes.description: Supersedes only the closure implication of D-244, which stays as historical provenance. SETUP-SPIKE-000 stays open while S2-S4 or their residuals are non-terminal; derived tiers read transfer mapped, closure pending.

nodes.label: D-249: bounded SM05/SM06 outcomes, partial CR-19
nodes.description: V1-SM05 is a limited Route-1 evidence slice that records and displays business-stage, role, task and evidence facts without claiming transition:T* execution. V1-SM06 adds board and audit visibility plus the bounded LinkedIn ManualReady event, with no Published state, WordPress delivery or live-URL confirmation. Both disclose partial CR-19 satisfaction.

nodes.label: D-250: five-dimension ManualReady contract
nodes.description: Eligibility needs an accepted final business:T5 record; ROLE-SENIOR-JOURNALIST is the sole authorized virtual-agent requester by explicit Judge grant; readiness binds to the exact accepted formatted-content snapshot; refusal mutates nothing but may append refusal evidence; identical replay creates no second effective outcome. Physical revision identity, idempotency key and query are Lane B's later work.

nodes.label: D-251: ACCESS-ROLE-CHIEF-EDITOR namespace correction
nodes.description: Renames the natural-person access entitlement ROLE-CHIEF-EDITOR to ACCESS-ROLE-CHIEF-EDITOR and reserves ROLE-* for virtual-agent identities. Identifier correction only; no accountability or authority moves and historical text is preserved. Carries the identity-migration ledger; no code, schema or stored value is renamed.
